Epanolol, a related beta-amino alcohol, has absolute oral bioavailability of 5.85 ± 2.55% with food, and DHPG has absolute oral bioavailability of 5.4 ± 1.6% in humans.
Terfenadine, a lipophilic drug with extensive first-pass metabolism, has oral bioavailability below 5% in L1 and L2 records, supporting low F for lipophilic high-clearance molecules.

C22 reports a 10-35% range for I3C that spans the 20% threshold, leaving that context ambiguous.
